configuration: PKP-660-PKP scattering demo (explosion): six Hi network receivers from 62.6 to 66.0 degrees, an explosion at 630 km depth (0.0 N, 32.0 E), the 8-zone base model of the scenario, omega_imag 1.1e-3, 4000 s window (TIME_LENGTH_DSM_1D of its Par_file). The deck runs at SAB_NFREQ=32 frequencies (f <= 0.008 Hz) on 8 MPI ranks instead of the upstream 8192 frequencies (hours on hundreds of ranks); the reference is regenerated at the same count on the pinned build. Graded: the complex displacement spectrum (vertical and radial) of every receiver at each of the 32 graded frequencies, and the vertical and radial displacement seismograms spectotime forms from them (2048 samples over -4000 to 4000 s).
observable: the complex displacement spectrum (vertical and radial) of every receiver at each of the 32 graded frequencies, and the vertical and radial displacement seismograms spectotime forms from them (2048 samples over -4000 to 4000 s)
variant: ic/variant moves every receiver distance in DATA/dist_solid_list and DATA/dist_fluid_list by +1e-07 degrees (about 1.1 cm of epicentral distance; the two tables must stay equal entry by entry because param.f stops when they differ by more than 1e-10 rad), nothing else. It is generic noise calibration: an input change far inside any real station-location uncertainty that every graded value responds to continuously, since the spectra depend on distance through the Legendre functions of the receiver angle. Two ulps of the distance (about 3e-14 degrees) were rejected as the perturbation: on the ULVZ deck they move the binary64 spectra by 4e-13 relative, below the 8e-9 relative floor of the FMA rebuild, so they would calibrate compiler noise, not input sensitivity (first packager's measurement, confirmed here: 1e-6 degrees moves the ULVZ deck's spectra by 1.5e-6 of the file peak and 1e-7 degrees by 1.5e-7 (spectra) and 1.1e-7 (seismograms), 2502 of 4352 graded values changed, a linear response).
altbuild: run.sh altbuild rebuilds the same two Fortran sources rebuilt with FMA contraction enabled (-O2 -mfma on both Makefiles, the SAC side keeping -fallow-argument-mismatch -std=legacy) instead of the upstream -O and -O3; a correct candidate could plausibly ship an FMA-contracted build on any FMA-capable x86-64 host, and contracting a*b+c into one rounding really changes the arithmetic (the first packager measured -O against -O0 bit-identical, so that pair is not usable as an alternative build here).

comparison.meaning: |candidate - reference| <= rtol * max|reference| within each graded file (validate.py); a per-file scale because one check spans files that differ by many decades of amplitude and every stream crosses zero

files.what: complex displacement spectrum, vertical (record 1) and radial (record 2) components of every receiver; record 3 (transverse) is identically zero for an explosion and is not graded
displacement seismograms written by spectotime, vertical and radial component of every receiver, 2048 binary32 samples on the fixed grid from -T to T

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck: run.sh altbuild (FMA rebuild) against run.sh nominal, graded with this check's validate.py
evidence.fault_probes_how: native runs of the ULVZ explosion deck at 32 frequencies on 8 ranks (x86-64, gfortran 13.3, OpenMPI 4.1.6), each probe graded against the nominal run with this validator; keys ending in _spec are the worst |err| / file peak over the 32 binary64 spectrum files (vertical and radial, two receivers), _sac over the four binary32 seismograms; cutoff500 changed no value
evidence.tolerance_rationale: rtol 1e-05 of the file peak: two decades inside the 1e-3 seismological equivalence level, three decades above the measured FMA floor (1e-8) and at least 13 times under the nearest measured fault (a half-resolution radial grid, 2e-4 in the spectra); the 1e-7 degree variant sits about 60 times under it; see the warrant

warrant: The graded quantity is the displacement field the module exists to produce: the frequency-domain Green's displacement dsmti writes for each receiver (binary64, before any post-processing) and the seismogram spectotime forms from it (the quantity a seismologist reads). Positions are physical identities (component, receiver in the order of the deck's tables, frequency index, time sample), never storage; the DC file freq_00000 and the identically-zero components are excluded because a zero array grades nothing. The bound is 1e-05 of each graded file's own peak magnitude, two decades inside the 1e-3 level at which two synthetic seismograms are the same answer in this field, and placed from the measured landscape of the ULVZ explosion deck at this band (worst |err| / file peak, spectra and seismograms): a ten-times coarser radial grid (6000 points) moves the graded values by 0.00098 and 0.0012, a two-times coarser one (30000) by 0.0002 and 0.00024, truncating the angular-order sum at l=100 by 0.0013 and 0.00013, dropping the imaginary frequency offset (omega_imag=0, no damping of the time-domain wraparound) by 2.6e+02 and 1.7; truncating at l=500, the last block the every-500-orders convergence test (check_amp_significance, eps 1e-12 on squared amplitude) could ever drop, changes no value at all, so a build that flips that discrete test cannot move a graded value. Every fault is at least 13 times above the bound. It is achievable because the algorithm is a deterministic linear solve with no iteration, no random draw and no reduction across ranks (each rank owns whole frequencies): the FMA rebuild moves the graded values by 1e-08 and 2.9e-08 of peak, three decades under the bound, and the 1e-7 degree variant by about 1.5e-07 and 1.1e-07. The bound is set by the packager (a decade rule anchored on the seismological equivalence level), which is why these fault probes are recorded. The check is not chaotic: there is no time stepping and no error growth; every frequency is an independent solve.
